articles.title: Wall Street gets new crypto rival after Texas bank completes regulatory pivot
articles.snippet: By establishing a national charter under the executive branch, United Texas Bank said it intends to enable AI-driven payment rails to intercept global digital dollar volumes.

articles.title: BIS project finds tokenization could make cross-border payments faster, safer
articles.snippet: Project Agorá, backed by major central banks, will now move toward "real-value" testing to settle tokenized central bank money and bank deposits on blockchain rails.
